metadata.title: When you land a kill and are still wondering how it happened in VALORANT
metadata.description:
That kill was pure accident, and even I’m shocked.
Did the game just glitch or did I actually play?
Watch me fake confidence after this one.

Click if you’ve ever scored a kill by pure luck!

#valorant #gaming #funny #clutch #fails
